_why: TASK-841 (FE, REQ-132). One clicked test file: the Attention page's anchors (href + label), the URL the Bookings page reads, and the hook that opens the plan window once. M1 the link dropped, M2 the wrong id in the URL, M3 ?course= ignored on load, M4 a voucher link under the wrong key, M5 no kind check, M6 reopens, M7 opens without loading, M8 the Bookings page stops using the hook.

mutations.what: 🔴 the link is dropped (every item is plain text again)
🔴 the wrong id in the URL (the kind where the id belongs)

edits.to: const course = null as string | null;

mutations.what: a voucher link is written under ?course=
an id of the OTHER kind opens a window (no kind check)
the window REopens after the admin closed it (the once-guard is gone)
🔴 the window opens before the plan has loaded (an unknown id would open an error window)

edits.from:
if (!request || done.current || !plan.data) return;
    if (plan.data.kind !== request.kind) return;

mutations.what: the Bookings page stops opening the window from the link
